recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, vertical black rectangular box stands against a pure white void. Inside the box, a man in a textured pink suit sits on the floor with his legs extending out toward the viewer. Above his head, an airplane window reveals a clear blue sky. The composition is strictly symmetrical and high-contrast.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's pink suit provides the primary color contrast against the black interior and white exterior.
The verticality of the black box mimics the shape of a coffin or a narrow cabin.
The airplane window acts as a secondary focal point, suggesting an external world or escape.
The subject's bare, slightly dirty feet grounding the image against the surreal, floating box.
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no horizon line
Matte black interior of the vertical structure
Soft, diffused studio lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated at the bottom third of a tall, narrow vertical rectangle that occupies the center 25% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's pink suit and the black box structure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves up to the airplane window, then down the legs to the bare feet extending out of the frame's box.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central monolith, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white void and black box; desaturated, earthy tones in the suit and skin.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans-serif for utilitarian metadata.
graphicDevices: Rectangular black containment box for text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, all-caps aesthetic of standard advisory labels.
Provides the necessary clean, industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution studio portrait of a man in a dusty pink linen suit sitting inside a tall, narrow matte black vertical box. The box is centered on a pure white background. An oval airplane window is visible inside the box above the man's head, showing a blue sky. The man's bare feet should extend out of the box toward the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small black rectangular block in the bottom right corner. Inside this block, typeset three lines of white condensed sans-serif text in all-caps, centered.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with no floor line?
Is the pink suit a desaturated, textured linen?
Is the airplane window oval and centered above the head?
Are the feet bare and extending outside the black box?

adjustableVariables: Suit color (e.g., sage green or charcoal)
Window view (e.g., night sky or sunset)
Subject pose (e.g., looking at camera or eyes closed)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any specific brand logos on the clothing
Exact wording of the advisory label
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black box has sharp, clean edges.
Check that the lighting on the feet matches the lighting on the body.
Verify the white background is completely blown out to #FFFFFF.
Confirm the text block is perfectly aligned to the bottom right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Monolith + Subject in Contrast Color + Surreal Portal + White Void
